conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Arnav Gupta. Mera credit card ka statement physical copy kaise milega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Arnav ji, main aapki madad karoonga. Kya aap apna card number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Aapke registered address pe physical statement bheja ja sakta hai. Kya aap annual subscription ke liye apply karna chahte hain? Ya ek baar ka statement chahiye?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Bas ek baar ka chahiye. Kitna charge hoga?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Ek baar ke liye ₹100 charge hai. Main request daal deta hoon, 7 din mein statement aapke address pe aa jayega. Theek hai?
